info.title: WANI API
info.description: Backend API for WANI — WhatsApp-based AI commerce assistant

post.summary: Process an inbound WhatsApp message through the AI pipeline

ownerId.description: Owner ID (optional, defaults to first user)

post.summary: Upsert QR session data (from WhatsApp bridge)
Clear pairing code so a new one is generated

oneOf.description: Empty object when no config exists

put.summary: Update order status (with stock management, WhatsApp notification)
Update order payment (auto-confirms order on PAID)

get.summary: Get customer detail with orders and conversation

post.summary: Send a message as HUMAN to the conversation

delete.summary: Delete a generation and its files

get.summary: Get undelivered outgoing messages (for WhatsApp bridge)

ApiKeyAuth.description: Static API token from the `API_TOKEN` env var. Used by webhook-style internal endpoints (chat, outgoing, QR write). Set via `bun run api:token:set` or in the .env file.

BearerAuth.description: JWT obtained from `POST /api/auth/login`. Used by all dashboard / CRUD endpoints.

storeId.description: Store UUID — must belong to the current user

storeName.description: Store name — must match the current user's store name
